name: TP-Link Omada
author: Netlens
description: Reads the Omada controller (software controller, OC200/OC300 or Omada Cloud-less hardware, version 5.1 or newer): gateway, switches and access points, which device hangs below which, which switch or access point every client is on, with Wi-Fi signal and link rate, the ports of every switch (link, speed, duplex, traffic), and each device's processor, memory, uptime and firmware (with a waiting upgrade). With an Open API client it also reads the application statistics (DPI). Read-only.

config.label: Controller address
config.help: The address you open the Omada web interface at, including the port (8043 for the software controller, 443 for an OC200/OC300 or when a reverse proxy is used).

config.label: Username
config.help: Use a separate account with the Viewer role (Omada: Settings > Admin). It never needs to change anything.

config.label: Site
config.help: The name of one site, exactly as shown in Omada. Leave empty to read every site the account may see.

config.label: Open API client ID (application statistics)
config.help: Optional. Only needed for the Statistics > Network > Applications figures, which need DPI switched on at the gateway. Create a client in Omada: Settings > Platform Integration > Open API > Add New App, access mode Client Credentials, role Viewer. Leave empty to skip the statistics.

config.label: Open API client secret
config.help: The secret of that Open API client.

config.label: Verify TLS certificate
config.help: Omada controllers use a self-signed certificate unless you installed your own. Leave this off in that case.
